Ram Temple Donation Irregularities Lead to Arrests and Investigations

Allegations of financial irregularities concerning donations to the Ram temple in Ayodhya have led to the arrest of eight individuals. Investigations are now extending to bank accounts and involve questioning key figures associated with the temple trust. The issue has also sparked political debate and scrutiny over temple financial safeguards.
